page.layout: One photographed book spine, shown upright on a dark background. No printed page of text is visible.
page.notes: This is a photograph of a book spine, not a printed page. The gold-tooled lettering on the spine reads, from top to bottom: "...REF: ASSER..." (the first word is cut off at the edge), "...OSN. RES..." and "AD 3 LIB.". The start and end of each line are cut off, so the full title cannot be recovered. A small dark tooled panel in the middle carries a worn gold ornament, with no legible text. The paper label near the foot ("Bc / 926 / 926x") is a library shelf mark and is left out.
